events.content:
Implemented a server component that renders a welcome message and logs page views using Next’s post-response API (`after`).

- Updated `app/page.tsx:1` to:
  - remain a Server Component (`async` page),
  - read `user-agent` during render (`headers()`),
  - schedule analytics logging with `after(async () => ...)` so it does not block the response.
- Added `app/lib/analytics.ts:1` with `logPageView(event)`:
  - sends a `POST` to `process.env.ANALYTICS_ENDPOINT` when configured,
  - falls back to `console.info` if no endpoint is set.

Validation:
- `npm run build` passes successfully.

Note:
- Next.js updated `tsconfig.json:17` (`jsx: "react-jsx"`) and include paths during build, which is expected for this version.

If you want, I can also add a tiny `app/api/analytics/route.ts` endpoint so this logs to an in-app service by default instead of requiring an external URL.

item.text:
Implemented a server component that renders a welcome message and logs page views using Next’s post-response API (`after`).

- Updated `app/page.tsx:1` to:
  - remain a Server Component (`async` page),
  - read `user-agent` during render (`headers()`),
  - schedule analytics logging with `after(async () => ...)` so it does not block the response.
- Added `app/lib/analytics.ts:1` with `logPageView(event)`:
  - sends a `POST` to `process.env.ANALYTICS_ENDPOINT` when configured,
  - falls back to `console.info` if no endpoint is set.

Validation:
- `npm run build` passes successfully.

Note:
- Next.js updated `tsconfig.json:17` (`jsx: "react-jsx"`) and include paths during build, which is expected for this version.

If you want, I can also add a tiny `app/api/analytics/route.ts` endpoint so this logs to an in-app service by default instead of requiring an external URL.
